```{r}
library(glmnet)
df_url="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jmayberr/math133-stat-learning-fall2026/refs/heads/main/Datasets/election2016.csv"
election2016=read.csv(df_url)
```

Define predictor matrix and response vector:

```{r}
y=election2016$trump.vote
predictors=names(election2016)[2:9]
formula=reformulate(predictors,response="trump.vote")
X=model.matrix(formula,data=election2016)[,-1]
```

Tune $\lambda$ using `cv.glmnet`

```{r}
set.seed(1)
lasso_cv=cv.glmnet(X,y,alpha=1,nfolds=10) #alpha = 0 for ridge
plot(lasso_cv)
```

Fit optimal model:

```{r}
lasso_best=glmnet(X,y,lambda =lasso_cv$lambda.min,alpha=1)
coef(lasso_best)
```

Calculate predictions:

```{r}
yhat=predict(lasso_best,newx=X)
head(cbind(election2016$state,yhat))
```

Standardized coefficients

```{r}
s=apply(X,2,sd)
std.coef=s*coef(lasso_best)[-1]
sort(abs(std.coef),decreasing = TRUE)
```
